lessons.title: BLIP-2: Q-Former Bridge
lessons.hook: BLIP-2 bridges vision and language with an 11B LLM.
lessons.body: BLIP-2 uses a frozen OPT-6.7B LLM with a trainable Q-Former. The Q-Former extracts visual features and projects them into the LLM's embedding space.

lessons.title: Flamingo: Gated Cross-Attention
lessons.hook: Flamingo trains on 1.3B image-text pairs with gated cross-attention.
lessons.body: Flamingo uses ALIGN (1.8B pairs) and LTIP (2.6B pairs) datasets, totaling 4.4B pairs. Gated cross-attention layers are inserted between frozen LM blocks.

corrections.note: Body states ALIGN + LTIP had 4.4B pairs total

lessons.title: LLaVA: Visual Instruction Tuning
lessons.hook: LLaVA-1.5 introduces AnyRes for variable resolution and scales context 2048→32k.
lessons.body: LLaVA-1.5 uses a ~22M parameter projector. AnyRes is introduced in LLaVA-NeXT, not LLaVA-1.5. LLaVA-1.5 context is 2048; 32k context comes in LLaVA-NeXT.

corrections.note: AnyRes attributed to LLaVA-NeXT in body

lessons.title: Any Resolution: Patch-n-Pack
lessons.hook: Aspect ratio 9:16 with ~9,800 tokens filling most of 8k context.
lessons.body: The problem section cites 1:3 aspect ratio. ~9,800 tokens exceeds an 8k context window.

lessons.title: LLaVA-OneVision: Single/Multi/Video
lessons.hook: Bilinear pooling of 24×24 patches to 12×12 is a 4x reduction per dimension.
lessons.body: Halving each side (24→12) is a 2x reduction per dimension, yielding 4x fewer tokens total.

corrections.note: Halving each dimension = 2x reduction per dimension

lessons.title: Emu3: Next-Token for Generation
lessons.hook: Llama-2-7B trained in 2k-4k GPU-years on A100; smaller codebook lookups with 32,768 entries.
lessons.body: Llama 2 paper reports ~184k A100 GPU-hours for 7B (~21 GPU-years). 32,768-entry codebook is large, not small.

lessons.title: Transfusion: Autoregressive Diffusion
lessons.hook: Unified generation in one forward pass with 10-30 diffusion steps; Claude Opus 4.7 generates images.
lessons.body: The 10-30 step diffusion loop contradicts single forward pass. Claude Opus 4.7 image generation claim unverified.

lessons.title: Show-o: Discrete Diffusion Unified
lessons.hook: Three tasks unified in one model.
lessons.body: Four tasks: (1) text-to-image, (2) image-to-text, (3) text-to-text, (4) image-to-image.

lessons.title: MIO: Any-to-Any Streaming
lessons.body: Stated ranges elsewhere sum to ~60k entries.

lessons.title: Long Video: Million Token Context
lessons.hook: Three scaling paths with linear compute/memory via ring attention.
lessons.body: Four scaling sections below. Ring attention makes communication linear; total attention compute stays quadratic.

corrections.note: Ring attention: communication linear, compute stays quadratic

lessons.title: Audio-Language: Whisper to AF3
lessons.body: Uses Qwen2 7B as the LLM backbone, not 8B.

lessons.title: Omni Models: Thinker-Talker
lessons.hook: Three patterns; TTFAB 7B component maxima sum to 510ms.
lessons.body: Two patterns described. TTFAB 7B maxima sum to ~490ms.

lessons.title: ColPali: Vision-Native RAG
lessons.body: Exercise 1 cites 8x compression factor; ~4 MB after PQ conflicts with this.

lessons.title: Multimodal Agents: Computer Use
lessons.hook: Agents execute 10 atomic actions for computer control.
lessons.body: Nine actions: (1) click, (2) double-click, (3) right-click, (4) type, (5) scroll, (6) drag, (7) keypress, (8) wait, (9) screenshot.

corrections.note: Body lists nine actions, not ten
